title: Adamantium vs Vibranium: You're Getting This Wrong
full_script_text: This is Adamantium. This is Vibranium. So what's the difference? Most people think they both just block bullets. They don't. Adamantium is a man-made alloy engineered for pure, rigid hardness. It never bends, deforms, or absorbs kinetic impact. But Vibranium is an extraterrestrial metal that absorbs kinetic energy directly into its atomic bonds, nullifying momentum instantly. Adamantium completely resists physical force, while Vibranium completely neutralizes it. Next is Mjolnir vs Stormbreaker. Follow so you don't miss it.
final_rule_outro: Adamantium completely resists physical force, while Vibranium completely neutralizes it.
